purpose: Set-level hash closing the freeze coverage gap: the manifest's own hash covers only its payload and questions.txt, while questions.md carries the classification, the scoring rules and the discriminator audit. This file covers ALL THREE. It is ADDITIVE - no frozen artifact was modified to produce it, so the manifest hash and the questions.txt hash are unchanged.
hash_scheme: sha256-lf-v1 over the concatenation of <name>\0<lf-bytes>\0 in the order manifest.json, questions.txt, questions.md
